nodes.label: tender_fields_v1 Semantic Catalog
nodes.rationale: The catalog is the human-readable semantic source of truth for exactly 27 stable field_key values across worker, aggregation, recheck, finalization, and reporting layers.

nodes.label: Safe not_found Semantics
nodes.rationale: not_found means a value could not be established after complete analysis and never implies no, not required, not applicable, or not provided.

nodes.label: Literal License Certificate Boundary
nodes.rationale: Field 22 admits only documents explicitly called a license or certificate and excludes permissions, registrations, passports, declarations, and participant registry extracts unless separately represented in application_documents.

nodes.label: Two Part Advance Contract Guarantee
nodes.rationale: Field 20 must separately cover contract-performance security and advance-return security within one stable field_key; evidence for one part cannot silently close the other.

nodes.label: Application Documents Completeness Contract
nodes.rationale: Field 27 requires complete retrieval of mandatory and conditional application materials before generating a concise presentation value, with conditions retained when omission would mislead.

nodes.label: Round 2 Fail Closed Route Guard
nodes.rationale: Only four field keys have field-specific Round 2 semantic rules; the other 23 must terminate as requires_review with audit and evidence preserved instead of using a generic resolver.
